 while True:

def diff_metrics(x,y,label):
 d=np.max(np.abs(x.astype(np.int16)-y.astype(np.int16)),axis=2); m=d>=3

 print(label,'DIFF_PIXELS',int(m.sum()),'FRAC',round(float(m.mean()),8),'BBOX',bbox,'Q',[round(float(v),2) for v in np.quantile(d[m],[.5,.95,.99,1])] if m.any() else [])
 return m
def red(im):
 r,g,b=im[:,:,0].astype(float),im[:,:,1].astype(float),im[:,:,2].astype(float)
 return (r>105)&(r>g*1.28)&(r>b*1.18)
